# norte

> norte is an open-source, two-pane (orthodox) file manager built around one headless Rust core. The terminal UI (`ntc`), a native window (`norte-gui`), a CLI (`norte`) and AI agents over MCP are all clients of the same core, which can run as a daemon they share. Every file operation is journaled with its author; agents work only inside scopes a person grants, under a policy that can require approval for each change.

Status: alpha (v0.3.0-alpha.10). Linux x86_64 binaries and a first, unsigned Windows x86_64 preview (NSIS installer or portable ZIP); macOS builds from source. License: AGPL-3.0 for the core and frontends; MIT or Apache-2.0 for the protocol, VFS providers, test kit and plugin SDK. No telemetry.

## Install

- Linux one-liner (installs `ntc` and `norte` into ~/.cargo/bin): `curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 -LsSf https://github.com/compilando/norte/releases/download/v0.3.0-alpha.10/norte-tui-installer.sh | sh && curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 -LsSf https://github.com/compilando/norte/releases/download/v0.3.0-alpha.10/norte-cli-installer.sh | sh`
- Window packages (.deb, .rpm, AppImage): https://github.com/compilando/norte/releases/tag/v0.3.0-alpha.10
- Windows preview, unsigned (NSIS installer or portable ZIP, each with the window, `norte` and `ntc`): https://github.com/compilando/norte/releases/download/v0.3.0-alpha.10/norte_0.3.0-alpha.10_x64-setup.exe · https://github.com/compilando/norte/releases/download/v0.3.0-alpha.10/norte-0.3.0-alpha.10-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc.zip
- From source (any OS, Rust 1.95+): `cargo install --git https://github.com/compilando/norte --tag v0.3.0-alpha.10 --locked norte-tui norte-cli`

## What it does

- Two panes with seven keymap presets: orthodox, vim, cua, krusader, far, norton, total-commander.
- One virtual filesystem: local disks, SFTP, FTP (TLS), S3-compatible storage, ZIP/TAR/RAR archives.
- Client-server: `norte daemon run`, then `ntc --daemon` from any number of terminals; running tasks, connections and the journal are shared.
- A journal of copies, moves, renames and deletes, each with its author: you, a script, or an agent's session.
- AI agents: `norte mcp serve --session <id>` (MCP over stdio). Tools: list_dir, stat, read_file, copy, move, delete, task_status, request_scope, compare, sync_plan. Scopes are granted with `norte policy grant <id>`; `policy.toml` rules (first match wins) allow, ask or deny per operation, path, scheme and actor.
- WASM plugins (wasm32-wasip2), sandboxed, each capability approved by a person.
- Compare and one-way sync of two trees, with a reviewable plan.
